{{2017–18 Horizon League men's basketball standings}}
The '''2017–18 Detroit Titans men's basketball team''', also known as Detroit Mercy, represented the [[University of Detroit Mercy]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Titans, led by second-year head coach [[Bacari Alexander]], played their home games at [[Calihan Hall]] as members of the [[Horizon League]]. They finished the season 8–24, 4–14 in Horizon League play to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]] to [[2017–18 Green Bay Phoenix men's basketball team|Green Bay]].

On March 26, 2018, the school fired head coach Bacari Alexander after two seasons.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/2018/03/26/detroit-mercy-fires-bacari-alexander/459436002/|title=Bacari Alexander out as Detroit Mercy's basketball coach after 2 seasons|newspaper=[[Detroit Free Press]]|first=Perry A.|last=Farrell|date=March 26, 2018|accessdate=March 26, 2018}}</ref> On June 5, the school hired [[Texas Southern Tigers basketball|Texas Southern]] head coach [[Mike Davis (basketball coach)|Mike Davis]] as the Titans' new coach.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2018/06/05/detroit-mercy-to-hire-mike-davis-as-head-coach/|title=Detroit Mercy to hire Mike Davis as head coach|date=2018-06-06|work=CollegeBasketballTalk|access-date=2018-06-13|language=en-US}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 Detroit Titans men's basketball team|Titans]] finished the season 8–23, 6–12 in Horizon League play to finish in seventh place. As the No. 7 seed in the [[2017 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]], they lost [[2016–17 Milwaukee Panthers men's basketball team|Milwaukee]] in the first round.
